policy: Documented contextual review is not a verified DraftKings-to-GSIS mapping. Only an independently evidenced ID bridge can support that promotion.

reviews.finding: The Buccaneers roster uses Kenny Gainwell while the same club's signing coverage uses Kenneth Gainwell. The catalog and crosswalk agree on ESPN 4371733. This explains the name discrepancy; it does not independently bind either DraftKings ID to GSIS.

Washington lists Chig Okonkwo; the NFL-hosted Titans media guide records his full name as Chigoziem Charlton Okonkwo. Catalog and crosswalk agree on ESPN 4360635. This documents the name variant, not a DraftKings ID bridge.

Minnesota describes Max Bredeson as a fullback. DraftKings/catalog use RB while the crosswalk uses TE. Catalog and crosswalk agree on ESPN 4878695. Preserve DraftKings roster eligibility; do not globally equate TE and RB or verify identity from the shared name.
